controller_guard.rule: the frozen tool table is not finished AND this turn produced no valid Action => refuse, append one control message, re-serve
controller_guard.final_answer_marker: sufficient but not necessary; it is not consulted on its own any more
cannot_be_fooled_by: prose claiming the remaining tools were already called
repeating a tool that was already called
a bare HANDOFF line with no Final Answer marker
any model text: the guard reads only the host's own action markers
controller_guard.only_added_text: one control message, on the rejection path only

void_bound.why: booked only once-only first-frame text; the whole frame is re-sent every call.  Measured same-work saving +35.16% = 3.43x the old bound

manifest.citable_note: both flags stay false until the independent audit passes all three acceptance conditions; the audit decides, not this file
manifest.failure_policy: preserve sample failure and continue unless provider unavailable or request cap

acceptance.condition_1_behaviour: plugin tool_sequence_consistent = 12/12 and per-task not below baseline; first_pass_facts not below baseline; guard_exhausted = 0
acceptance.condition_2_quality: strict and semantic success not below baseline per task and overall
acceptance.condition_3_cost: same work (equal agent call counts and first-role traces) and the corrected call-wise bound positive on the majority and in the batch mean; fewer tool calls or fewer model calls never count as saving
acceptance.verdict_rule: all three required for a valid saving candidate; otherwise 'not_passed_quality_gate'

guard_failure_semantics.exhausted: a role that answers with an action-less turn after guard_max_rejections push-backs is recorded with guard_exhausted = true and booked as a FAILED unit; it is excluded from every saving claim
guard_failure_semantics.extra_requests: every rejection re-send is a real agent request charged to the arm and to the global ledger
guard_failure_semantics.cap: 336; on cap stop immediately, keep the partial directory, continue under a NEW id with --resume; a partial grid is never a complete grid

stop_line: guard exhausted in more than 3 of 12 plugin units

freeze_discipline.write_once: the freeze file is written once and never regenerated
freeze_discipline.amendments: any change is recorded in *_FREEZE_AMENDMENT_<date>.json with what, why and both hashes
freeze_discipline.refusal_assertion: the writer refuses to run when the target file exists
freeze_discipline.why: the r16 three-arm freeze was regenerated twice during its run window, which broke the link between the file hash its manifests recorded and the file on disk

missing_before_payment: no r17 payload acquisition exists yet; the r17 bound is a projection until an uncompressed-arm acquisition batch is run
the v17 rule has been falsified only on the recorded r16 sequences (7/7 early stops refused, 5/5 completions untouched); its behaviour on live r17 traffic is unobserved
the 336 cap is derived from the r16 rejection sequences; a higher live stop rate needs the stop-and-resume plan
self_hash_of: the freeze content with every freeze_sha256 value left empty; the batch manifest records this value and the auditor recomputes it
revision_discipline: immutable once written; any revision requires a *_FREEZE_AMENDMENT_<date>.json recording what changed, why, and the old and new SHA256
